==Notes==
*The special temporary skills given by this temporary Raven Blessing equate to those of [[Raven Blessing]] at rank 4; however, the mechanics of this skill itself are completely different because it was not changed along with Raven Blessing.
*Equipping a weapon with a [[zealous]] mod will not alter the -2 energy degeneration, but you will benefit from its energy gain when hitting with an attack, which can help in maintaining Raven Blessing.
